svg.text: Prasad MK · Fact extraction, authority resolution and passage retrieval, Python standard library only
Five crawls of the site, fed to ks.ingest() oldest first: 01 2026-05-12 · 02 2026-05-19 · 03 2026-06-09 · 04 2026-08-27 · 05 2026-09-28 (latest), 3,294 pages in total

g.text: PHASE 1: INGESTION PIPELINE, ks.ingest(snapshot) [5.4 s for all 5 snapshots]
Content-hash cache · all heavy work happens here
PHASE 2: PER-SNAPSHOT RESOLUTION & INDEXING (In-Memory Views per Snapshot)
1. Authority Tier (A: ≥80, B: ≥50, C: <50) 2. Effective Date
3. Published Date 4. Table > Prose 5. Support Count
• Org counts ('22 branches') rank by Published Date first
• Per-snapshot BM25 index over blocks & table rows
• Excludes listing & expired pages; chunks >1500 chars
• Weighted by page authority + publication year recency
CONFLICTS: ks.conflicts() (15% of the final score)
• One entry per (product, term): its base tier with a contradiction; copies merged
• Table values compete when present (ignores stray blog prose percentages)
• Drops same-quote values; ordinals.py adds repeated claims (4th vs 5th time)
• Explains resolution reason (expired offer, lower-authority calc/blog, earlier crawl)
→ List[Conflict(topic, values, sources, resolution, reason)]: 25 entries
PHASE 3: QUERY ROUTING AND ANSWERING, ks.answer(question, as_of=None)
Public set: p95 0.01 s · repeat and paraphrase checks 1.00
• Extracts explicit as_of or inline date
• Picks newest snapshot ≤ target date and
uses that snapshot's 6a view and 6b index
• Fact Router: table winners on pages ≥50,
then ≥80 only if a rate sheet or product page has it
or the full product table for broad questions
• BM25 top-80 reranked by section IDF
and names the site never mentions

svg.text: To harness/run_eval.py: one Answer(text, sources, confident, conflict_note) per question, and the conflict list once at the end
